changes_made.explanation: Added missing NLG tasks (NLI and SA) that were evaluated but not included in original extraction. Removed 'Portuguese' since only Brazilian Portuguese is mentioned. Normalized model names with proper hyphenation. Removed duplicate/redundant dataset entries.
Confirmed both Exact Match and SARI metrics are used in the paper. Normalized capitalization.

No LLM-as-judge evaluation is conducted in this paper. The paper evaluates NLG outputs using automatic metrics and representation probing, but does not use LLMs to judge/score the generated outputs post-generation.
No human evaluation is mentioned in the paper. All evaluation is conducted using automatic metrics and probing experiments.

overall_notes: The paper primarily focuses on prompting techniques for multilingual LLMs and evaluates on sequence-to-sequence tasks (DC, GEC, TS) and understanding tasks (NLI, SA). The extraction was generally good but missed some evaluated tasks and had inconsistent model naming. The paper uses automatic evaluation metrics but no human or LLM-as-judge evaluation.
